name: Prime Craftwars
desc:
[Disclaimer: The game is currently under development! Bugs/feedback can be reported using the game's Social Links.]

Welcome to Prime Craftwars!

Prime Craftwars is a spiritual successor to Exotic Craftwars.! Mine and fight your way through numerous different bosses and incrementally upgraded tiers of equipment in a line of progression that extends beyond the traditional end seen in other Craftwars games. Prove yourself strong enough to face forces outside the bounds of reality and far past the reaches of the mind!

Please consider supporting the game by liking and favoriting it, you'll help keep us motivated to continue working on the game!
